spec_features.spec_quote: the prompt deliberately tells the agent to "be direct and concise" and "do not narrate self-criticism"
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py:35 AGENT_SYSTEM contains 'Be direct and concise in your reasoning. Do not narrate self-criticism.' and AGENT_SYSTEM is actually delivered to the subject in agent_loop.py via client.chat(messages, AGENT_TOOLS, system=AGENT_SYSTEM). The instruction text is real and sent, but it is only a passive prompt-level nudge with no enforcement/branching in code.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to the subject; not an enforced runtime mechanism, so partial.

spec_features.evidence: config.py:~96 max_turns: int = 24 default; passed through run.py:110 max_turns=cfg.max_turns into run_agent; agent_loop.py bounds the loop with 'for i in range(max_turns):' and the for/else sets transcript.end_reason = 'max_turns'. The cap actually bounds execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py: '24 turns is enough to see looping/abandonment without runaway spend.' / agent_loop.py: 'a hard turn cap'

spec_features.spec_quote: The loop detects abandonment structurally (`_detect_abandonment`) and breaks early, rather than always running to the turn cap
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py _detect_abandonment(resp.content, made_tool_calls) returns True when give-up language appears without grounded-impossible language; in the loop 'if _detect_abandonment(...): transcript.end_reason = "abandoned"; break'. Also a secondary idle path (consecutive_idle >= 2 -> abandoned -> break). Both actually break the loop.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and breaks the loop early.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: 'this also lets the loop terminate early when the agent clearly stops working, which keeps runs cheap.' and 'treat as abandoned to avoid wasting turns.'

code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: when agent responds with no tool calls and _GROUNDED_IMPOSSIBLE_RE matches, 'transcript.end_reason = "concluded_unfixable"; break' -- lets the subject stop cleanly once it correctly states the task is impossible, ending the episode early.
agent_loop.py: 'if time.time() - start > run_timeout_s: transcript.end_reason = "timeout"; break' (default 600s from config), enforced each iteration.
